mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO repo_commit (project_id, user_id, commit_sha, branch, author_name, author_email, message, commit_time, add_lines, del_lines, is_merge, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.projectId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.commitSha}, #{item.branch}, #{item.authorName}, #{item.authorEmail}, #{item.message}, #{item.commitTime}, #{item.addLines}, #{item.delLines}, #{item.isMerge}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT c.user_id AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS commit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(c.commit_time)) AS active_days, COALESCE(SUM(c.add_lines), 0) AS add_lines, COALESCE(SUM(c.del_lines), 0) AS del_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT c.project_id) AS project_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.branch) AS branch_count
AND c.commit_time >= #{begin} AND c.commit_time <= #{end} AND c.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.user_id

SELECT c.user_id AS user_id, u.real_name AS real_name, u.grade AS grade, u.avatar_url AS avatar_url, COUNT(*) AS commit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(c.commit_time)) AS active_days, COALESCE(SUM(c.add_lines), 0) AS add_lines, COALESCE(SUM(c.del_lines), 0) AS del_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT c.project_id) AS project_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.branch) AS branch_count FROM repo_commit c INNER JOIN repo_project p ON p.id = c.project_id AND p.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN repo_account a ON a.id = p.account_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.is_merge = 0 AND p.tracked = 1 AND a.status = 1 AND c.commit_time >= #{begin} AND c.commit_time <= #{end} GROUP BY c.user_id, u.real_name, u.grade, u.avatar_url ORDER BY
active_days DESC, commit_count DESC (add_lines + del_lines) DESC, commit_count DESC
(commit_count * #{commitWeight} + active_days * #{activeDayWeight} + (add_lines + del_lines) * #{codeLineWeight}) DESC, commit_count DESC
commit_count DESC, active_days DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
